decision: NX-024 (dispatcher ruling 2026-10-10): initial values from the approved design, kept as deployment configuration. self_window_seconds / self_trigger_cap bound reevaluations caused by a plan's own Run (M16: an event must not re-trigger itself indefinitely); min_reassess_seconds is the earliest a reassess_at may wake; run_budget is the ceiling of one reevaluation Run (docs/05 §6: 8 model turns, 12 tool calls, 300 s), further limited by the plan step budgets and the NX-022 model budget. v2 file (D-g option 2, owner 2026-10-13; dispatcher 2026-10-13): the same settings with the Run budget in CNY for a Host billing in CNY (no conversion). maximum_cost 2.00 CNY = the NX-037 per-Run cap; at a per-request reservation of 0.45 CNY that admits 4 model turns (1.80), so maximum_model_turns is 4 instead of 8 (a fifth reservation would exceed the cap anyway). plan-reevaluation.v1.json (USD) is unchanged.
